minor.issue: Netting guard only compares the requested amount to the CURRENT open reverse receivable; it never consumes/settles the reverse-direction documents. Two sequential nettings can each individually pass while cumulatively exceeding the reverse AR, re-introducing the F-08 imbalance. Also note the seed's real reverse open AR ent_ksc->ent_kanda is 4,153,398 (IC-00001 1,742,700 + IC-00002 1,887,888 + IC-00004 522,810), not the 522,810 quoted in the audit/POC — so netting KANDA/IC-00006 (remaining 3,240,000) is legitimately ACCEPTED. The guard was proven by the reverse-direction case (payer ent_kanda netting 4,153,398 > reverse open 3,240,000 -> 400 'melebihi piutang balik', nothing persisted).

rca_of_the_issue: Only one expectation from the review request failed, and it was a test-expectation/data issue, not a product defect: the request assumed the open reverse receivable ent_ksc->ent_kanda is ~522k, so netting KANDA/IC-00006 should be rejected. In the current (and freshly reset) seed the open reverse AR is 4,153,398 while IC-00006's remaining is 3,240,000, so the F-08 guard correctly allows it. The test was rewritten to derive amounts from Mongo and exercise the guard in the direction where the amount really does exceed the reverse AR (payer ent_kanda), which returns 400 with the 'melebihi piutang balik' message and persists nothing.
